name: Olimpo.KeyDerivation (.NET)
notes: Active server/desktop producer; uncompressed addresses are distinct candidates. 24-word only (word count validated exactly 24; 12-word rejected deterministically). Normalization: lowercase; split on space/tab/newline/CR; rejoin single spaces. HKDF-SHA256 info 'hush/signing/secp256k1/v1'/'hush/encrypt/secp256k1/v1'; invalid-scalar retry with '{info}/{attempt}'. Critical divergence from P-01: different HKDF info strings and different public-key encoding from the same mnemonic.
signatureBehavior: Olimpo.DigitalSignature SHA-256withECDSA over UTF-8 message bytes; DER default with compact 64-byte r||s and base64 variants; verification accepts DER or compact
